finding.title: Same-clock cross-output generation fingerprint regression: as_of-only coherence check is insufficient
finding.distinction: Narrow extension of 15:57 two-writer test: both runs use identical as_of_ms, so all three timestamps agree while underlying archive snapshots differ. Adds an independent content-level generation invariant, not a claim of a second confirmed defect.
procedure: Start with absent archive. Write B JSONL using json.dumps(FlowObservation(**b_jsonl_row).to_dict()) + newline. B row is available and effective before as_of, and ETF FLOW horizon supports one row.
Monkeypatch runner.atomic_write_json with a wrapper that invokes the original and, ONLY in A after latest.json write, sets A_paused and waits on release_A (10-second timeout). Do not pause B.

Start A with no input. Wait for A_paused (A already computed empty-archive frame). Start B with B JSONL and identical as_of_ms; join B with 10-second timeout, assert B returned normally. Release A in finally; join A with 10-second timeout and assert normal return.

Read latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json; compare timestamps AND coverage values: latest['coverage'], audit['coverage'], handoff['quality']['coverage']. Read archive with load_observations.
Run a sequential control C with network=False and no new input at same as_of_ms; assert all three coverage values converge and archive remains one row.
failing_expected_assertions: All three as_of_ms == 1800000000000 (this timestamp-only assertion PASSES despite mixing).
All three coverage values must be equal (source-predicted FAIL: latest=1/3 from B, audit=0 from A, handoff.quality=0 from A).
The final handoff source_evidence must agree with latest/audit ETF evidence, not represent A's empty history when latest is B.
Both runs succeed; B appends exactly one row, A zero; archive retains exactly one row with source_record_id=rowB and original provenance.
After sequential C, coverage matches across all three files (1/3), archive count remains one.
finding.why_distinct: The 15:57 oracle detects mixed generations by differing as_of_ms. This variant defeats that check with equal timestamps and verifies content-level snapshot coherence. No new Specialist code has been written.
